column3: Close to the Hebrew; הַחַשְׁמַל (“shining substance”), a rare word of uncertain meaning, is rendered “amber.”
Close to the Hebrew; the “ice/frost” of the Hebrew is rendered “crystal,” and the expanse “the firmament.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “His waist,” reading the figure as divine, and again renders חַשְׁמַל “amber.”
